description: Defines an interface for transactional state management with read/write locking semantics in Orleans framework. The interface includes methods for performing read-only and update operations on state objects within a transactional context.

methods.name: PerformRead
methods.description: Executes a read-only operation on the state and returns the result without modifying the state.

methods.name: PerformUpdate
methods.description: Executes an update operation on the state and returns the result.
